direct_claims: The chart shows fuel economy for new passenger vehicles across European countries in 2019.
Fuel economy is measured in liters per 100 kilometers traveled and represents the average for new passenger vehicle registrations.
The image is branded by Our World in Data, and the source line cites ICCT and the European Environment Agency (2021).
Countries shown without data are explicitly marked as having no data.
Approximate values visible from the legend range from about 4 to 9 liters per 100 kilometers.
Because the chart reports averages for new vehicle registrations, it reflects the characteristics of newly sold cars rather than the entire on-road vehicle fleet.
Since the chart is limited to 2019 and only to new registrations, it should not be interpreted as showing long-term change or the efficiency of all cars currently in use.
The geographic coverage is Europe-focused rather than global.
The source citation indicates the underlying data were compiled or reported in 2021, even though the measurement year shown is 2019.
